url_rules: Use Slovene wording with accent-free slugs: š→s, č→c, ž→z. Keep proper accents in visible titles and text.
Use one canonical URL for the same calendar intent; format/filter variations should not create redundant content pages.
Year pages remain fixed to their year. Evergreen hubs link to current and following years.
School years use paired-year labels such as 2026-2027 or 2029-2030 rather than a calendar-year-only label; verify publication status separately.
Month/year child pages require useful month-specific dates and output; do not mass-generate empty combinations.
Name-day search results and user-entered personalized calendars should not become public indexable profile pages by default.
recommended_information_architecture.launch_year_note: Primary required calendar coverage is 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030. October 2026 is the research/launch context. All four years need functional calendar, month, holiday, lunar and export coverage; 2027 can be the default entry year. School schedules are published only when officially confirmed, even where future calendar grids can be computed.

recommended_information_architecture.school_year_coverage_note: School-year records may span the boundaries of 2027–2030 (for example 2026-2027 through 2030-2031); include only officially published schedules and label unavailable years honestly.
